footnotes.footnote: This Form 4 reports securities disposed of under the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated May 12, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement"), by and among the Issuer, SpringX Holdings Limited ("Parent"), AutumnX Holdings Limited ("Holdco"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent and SummerX Holdings Limited ("Merger Sub"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Holdco. Pursuant to be Merger Agreement, Merger Sub was merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer being the surviving company of the Merger as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Holdco. Upon completion of the Merger, the Issuer became a privately-held company.

Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger (the "Effective Time"), each Class A ordinary share, par value US$0.0001 per share, of the Issuer (each, a "Class A Ordinary Share") issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, was cancelled and ceased to exist in exchange for the right to receive US$0.4940 in cash per Class A Ordinary Share, without interest, and each American depositary share, each representing six Class A Ordinary Shares (each, an "ADS"), together with the Class A Ordinary Shares represented by such ADS, was canceled in exchange for the right to receive US$2.9641 in cash per ADS, without interest, in each case subject to the terms and conditions of the Merger Agreement. The Class A Ordinary Shares reported in this row were held in the form of ADSs. See Footnote (3).

As previously reported on the Reporting Person's Form 3, the Reporting Person beneficially owned 2,800,000 Class A Ordinary Shares, held of record by Flawless Success Limited, which acts as a nominee for an employee trust holding shares for the benefit of grantees under the Issuer's share incentive plans. Such Class A Ordinary Shares were subsequently deposited with The Bank of New York Mellon in exchange for ADSs, which are held by Flawless Success Limited. Such deposit effected only a change in the form of beneficial ownership without changing the Reporting Person's pecuniary interest. Accordingly, the amounts reported herein are stated in terms of the underlying Class A Ordinary Shares rather than ADSs.
